pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with soft-to-medium edge pixel gradients. The geometry is most expansive on the upper flank and mid-neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented, and densely clustered units on the posterior and lower haunch.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing significantly between the smaller patches of the lower rump.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the upper neck and shoulder ridge. The mane presents a densely textured, uniform vertical silhouette against the background.
